summary.text: G. Seville Hatch is an independent write-in candidate on the general-election ballot for Arizona's 9th Congressional District and a telecommunications engineer and company founder.

paragraphs.text: Hatch was born in Dallas, Texas, attended Tempe High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the Motorola University Lab in 1983.

His career experience includes work as an engineer. In his Candidate Connection survey he describes himself as founder and CEO of ATCi, a satellite communications systems provider headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, which he says he took ownership of in 1992.

He has been affiliated with industry groups including the Society of Satellite Professionals, the World Teleport Association and the National Association of Broadcasters, and lists industry awards in his survey.
He is a write-in candidate on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot, running as an independent.
